verdict.rationale: Clara's marketing claims "automated expense reporting, approvals and compliance" (clara-docs-21), and its Card Configurations API can restrict cards by merchant category, time, and day of week (clara-docs-15). That gives only thin, glancing support for codifying policy and automating approvals. Missing for 10: documented policy rules engine with limits by category/role/context, auto-approval of in-policy expenses, exception routing to human approvers, role-based limits, independent or hands-on corroboration.
